services.desc: Although owning a jet ski is fantastic, it is not worth the money for a single trip to Lake Muskoka. Let’s review the reasons why renting a jet ski might be more practical than buying one. First of all, Jet Ski rentals in Lake Muskoka relieves you of the financial burden of upkeep and startup costs. After you buy a jet ski, the costs continue. In addition to the usual maintenance, you will need to purchase a storage facility to keep it in good condition during the off-season. Even if you do decide to buy a Jet Ski, never choose one that is too cheap or has been used before.
